cover.headline: Penrite goes big on the Dees.

rows.sub: Across the AFL and AFLW programs
Logo in two spots on the 2027 guernsey
FightMND march to the MCG comes with it

points.sub: Principal money goes to footy, not motorsport

others.deal: Anytime Fitness x West Coast Eagles
City National Bank x Vegas Golden Knights

caption:
Penrite just went from new kid to the front of the Dees jumper.

Penrite Oil is Principal Partner of Melbourne across the AFL and AFLW for two years, the biggest commercial partnership in the club's 168-year history. It only joined ahead of 2026, so that is one season to prove it. The partnership also hands Penrite the Walk to the 'G for FightMND.

Also in the database today: Toyota x Western Bulldogs, Anytime Fitness x West Coast Eagles, Lufthansa x DFB, City National Bank x Vegas Golden Knights and Ondas x Aston Martin F1.
